title: Two more ways to chat
summary:
Four community projects joined the lists: two chat tools, an image generator, and an open-source creative toolbox.

The Chat Projects list now includes Island AI, with multimodal chat, web search, and a mode that asks clarifying questions, and Botzy AI, a chatbot supporting Urdu, English, and Roman Urdu.

Visiora was added to the Vibe Coding project list. It turns text prompts into images with Flux, Turbo, and Kontext options, plus dimension and seed controls.

aitoolbox.software was added to the Creative Projects list, bringing a collection of AI-powered productivity and creativity tools to the showcase.
